main_text.p: dicitur, דליית בהון צרוך Quòd nulla in ipsis sit utilitas.

וְעֵינֵי לְאָה הָיוּ צִירְנֵיתָן Ch.Rotundus. Plural. צִירְנֵיתָא Et oculi Leæ erant rotundi, Genef.29.17. in Jonath. Apud Talmudicos צִירָן legitur pro eo, qui oculos nimis rotundos habet, quod in animali primogenito vitiosum habebatur.
צוּרְעָתָא, צוּרְעָא Ch. Idem, Levit.14,7.&32. in Targ.Jonath. Hinc Verbum in Ithpah. אִצְטָרַע Lepra percuti, leprosus fieri, Num.13.1.in Targ.Hierof.

צְרַף Ch. Conflare, purgare, defæcare, metalla proprie: metaphoricè Probare, explorare, Examinare: Item Associare, consociare, conjungere, ut Elias explicat. Futur. וְיִצְרְפוּן עַמְּהוֹן Et associabunt sibi, Num.24.24. in Targ.Hierosol. Jonathan habet ex Ithpahel יִצְטָרְפוּן. Sic & Genef.15.1.in Targ.Hierosol. Pahel צְרַף Idem.
צַרְפָּא Ch.Fusorium vas, Conflatorium, Prov.17.3. מִצְרָף Ch.Conflans, conflator, fusor, aurifaber, Genef. 36.39. in Targ.Hierosol.
צְרַר Ch. Ligare, colligare, contracte צַר. Ex Pahel Part.מְצַרְרִין Colligati, Jos.9.4.
צְרָרֵי, צְרָרִין צְרָרָא צְרַר Ch.Fasciculus, loculus. Plur.
קַבָּא קַבָּא Ch. Cabus, mensura frumentaria parva, sexta pars Seæ sive Sati.
קַבְתָּא Ch.Ventriculus, ingluvies, Deut.18.3. Heb. קִבָּה.
קוּבְתָא, קִבְתָּא, קִבָּא Ch. Lupanar, Numer.25.8. in Targ. Onk.

page.notes: The centred letter ק is a section letter. Hebrew and Chaldee vowel pointing is reproduced approximately; the Hebrew forms are read from a small scan and may contain errors. The right margin note "Onk." is at the foot of the last entry.
